name: lares
description: Give Codex sessions a local Lares companion.

interface.shortDescription: Give Codex sessions a local Live2D companion.
interface.longDescription: Lares turns a Codex session into a continuously animated desktop character — a Lar. Lifecycle hooks provide the baseline heartbeat; first-person MCP feel reports drive the expression. Nothing leaves the machine, and Lares never reads transcripts or guesses sentiment.
defaultPrompt: Let's play Twenty Questions: I'll think of something, you guess, and let Lares reflect your appraisal along the way.
来玩二十问猜谜吧：我先想一样东西，你来猜，让 Lares 呈现你一路上对局面的判断。
